mapper.select: /* systemsvc.MenuMapper.findMenus(메뉴 목록 조회) */ SELECT menu_id ,parent_menu_id ,menu_cd ,menu_nm ,menu_type ,path ,component ,icon ,depth ,sort_seq ,visible_yn ,use_yn ,remark ,created_by ,updated_by ,created_at ,updated_at FROM menus ORDER BY depth, parent_menu_id NULLS FIRST, sort_seq, menu_id

/* systemsvc.MenuMapper.findMenu(메뉴 상세 조회) */ SELECT menu_id ,parent_menu_id ,menu_cd ,menu_nm ,menu_type ,path ,component ,icon ,depth ,sort_seq ,visible_yn ,use_yn ,remark ,created_by ,updated_by ,created_at ,updated_at FROM menus WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}

/* systemsvc.MenuMapper.findMenuActions(메뉴 기능 목록 조회) */ SELECT action_id ,menu_id ,action_cd ,action_nm ,http_method ,api_pattern ,sort_seq ,use_yn ,created_by ,updated_by ,created_at ,updated_at FROM menu_actions WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY sort_seq, action_cd

/* systemsvc.MenuMapper.findMenusByRoleId(역할별 메뉴 목록 조회) */ SELECT m.menu_id ,m.parent_menu_id ,m.menu_cd ,m.menu_nm ,m.menu_type ,m.path ,m.component ,m.icon ,m.depth ,m.sort_seq ,m.visible_yn ,m.use_yn ,m.remark ,m.created_by ,m.updated_by ,m.created_at ,m.updated_at FROM role_menus rm INNER JOIN menus m ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.depth, m.parent_menu_id NULLS FIRST, m.sort_seq, m.menu_id
mapper.insert: /* systemsvc.MenuMapper.insertReferenceDataVersionHistory(기준정보 버전 변경 이력 등록) */ INSERT INTO reference_data_version_histories ( ref_type ,before_version_no ,after_version_no ,change_type ,target_table ,target_id ,change_summary ,changed_at ,changed_by ,created_by ,created_at ,updated_by ,updated_at ) SELECT ref_type ,version_no ,CONCAT( split_part(version_no, '.', 1), '.', split_part(version_no, '.', 2), '.', (COALESCE(NULLIF(split_part(version_no, '.', 3), ''), '0')::integer + 1)::text ) ,#{changeType} ,#{targetTable} ,#{targetId} ,#{changeSummary} ,current_timestamp ,#{changedBy} ,#{changedBy} ,current_timestamp ,#{changedBy} ,current_timestamp FROM reference_data_versions WHERE ref_type = #{refType}
